acceptance_tests: TEST-001: ERC clean - 0 errors, 0 unresolved warnings, all 10 baseline errors and 12 warnings dispositioned.
TEST-002: DRC clean against generic_two_layer - 0 errors, 0 unresolved warnings, all 7 baseline errors and 17 warnings dispositioned, 2 layers confirmed.
TEST-003: +3V3 measures 3.3 V +/-3% at 500 mA load from USB-C 5 V input.
TEST-004: I2C scan finds exactly one device at 0x48; TMP102 reads ambient within +/-2 degC over 15-35 degC.
constraints: Exactly two copper layers; layer 2 is a continuous GND pour (MECH-002).
Board outline fixed at 110 x 65 mm, 35,35 to 145,100 (MECH-001).
generic_two_layer DFM limits: trace >=0.15 mm, spacing >=0.15 mm, drill >=0.2 mm, copper-to-edge >=0.3 mm (MECH-003).
manufacturer_profile provenance is repository-chosen and not vendor-confirmed; any tightening must be re-verified with the real fabricator before release.
All logic at 3.3 V; no second logic voltage domain (PWR-002).
Total draw from the USB host limited to 500 mA (PWR-003).
OPEN QUESTION / DISCREPANCY: request specifies USB-C but J1 is Connector:USB_B_Micro; IF-005 assumes replacement with a USB-C receptacle and needs project_manager confirmation.
OPEN QUESTION: TMP102 ADD0 strap assumed to GND for address 0x48 (IF-004); confirm no address conflict downstream.
Proposal only - no project files, repository, or PCB data were modified in this stage.

interfaces.type: I2C (U1 GPIO21/GPIO22 to U2 TMP102, 4.7 kOhm pull-ups to +3V3, up to 400 kHz, address 0x48)
USB 2.0 full-speed data over USB-C receptacle (D+/D- to U1.USB_D+/USB_D-)

power.input: USB-C VBUS, 5 V nominal (4.75-5.25 V), single power source, 5.1 kOhm CC pulldowns for 5 V sink advertisement

requirements.statement: The board shall be powered solely from the USB-C receptacle VBUS input at nominal 5 V (4.75-5.25 V).

requirements.source: project request: keep logic at 3.3 V; PM gap: VBUS has no regulator path
requirements.statement: A linear regulator shall convert VBUS 5 V to the +3V3 rail; all logic on the board operates at 3.3 V nominal (+/-3%).

requirements.source: USB default sink budget; ESP32 peak current
requirements.statement: The +3V3 rail shall supply at least 500 mA continuous to cover ESP32-WROOM-32 RF peaks plus TMP102 and pull-ups; total board draw from VBUS shall not exceed 500 mA.

requirements.source: PM gap: no decoupling capacitors declared
requirements.statement: Decoupling shall be provided: 100 nF per supply pin at U1.3V3 and U2.VCC, plus 22 uF bulk on +3V3 and 10 uF on VBUS at the regulator.

requirements.source: PM gap: no EN pull-up/reset network
requirements.statement: U1.EN shall be pulled to +3V3 through a 10 kOhm resistor with a 100 nF capacitor to GND so the MCU releases reset after the rail is stable.

requirements.source: ERC baseline 10 errors; PM acceptance gate
requirements.statement: PWR_FLAG symbols shall drive the +3V3 and GND nets and every power_in pin (U1.1, U1.2, U2.1, U2.2) shall be connected to a driven rail, giving zero undriven-power-pin ERC errors.

requirements.source: request: monitor temperature over I2C; PM gap: I2C nets carry only pull-ups
requirements.statement: A single I2C bus at 3.3 V logic levels shall connect U1.GPIO21 (SDA) and U1.GPIO22 (SCL) to U2.SDA and U2.SCL; net I2C_SDA and I2C_SCL shall each have >=3 connections.
I2C_SDA and I2C_SCL shall each be pulled up to +3V3 by one 4.7 kOhm resistor (R1, R2) at a single location on the bus.
The I2C bus shall operate at standard/fast mode clock frequency up to 400 kHz with total bus capacitance under 400 pF.

requirements.source: PM gap: U2.GND on GND via ADD0 pin 5
requirements.statement: U2.ADD0 shall be strapped to GND to fix the TMP102 address at 0x48, and shall not be used as the device GND return; U2.GND (pin 2) shall carry the ground return.

requirements.source: request: USB-C; pin table shows Connector:USB_B_Micro (open question)
requirements.statement: One USB-C receptacle shall replace the USB_B_Micro (J1) footprint, with USB 2.0 D+/D- routed to U1.USB_D+/USB_D- and 5.1 kOhm CC1/CC2 pulldowns to advertise a 5 V sink; the USB_C vs USB_B_Micro discrepancy is flagged for resolution before schematic freeze.
The board outline shall remain 110 mm wide x 65 mm high (outline 35,35 to 145,100) and shall not grow.

requirements.source: request: stay within two-layer board; manufacturer_profile supported_layer_count 2
requirements.statement: The stackup shall be exactly two copper layers, with a continuous GND pour on layer 2; no additional layers permitted.
All copper shall respect the generic_two_layer profile: minimum trace width 0.15 mm, minimum spacing 0.15 mm, minimum drill 0.2 mm, and copper-to-edge clearance 0.3 mm.

requirements.source: PM workflow: layout and thermal isolation
requirements.statement: The USB-C receptacle shall be placed on a board edge with its mating face flush to the outline, and U2 (TMP102) shall be placed at least 15 mm from U1 and the regulator for thermal isolation; all packages hand-solderable.

requirements.source: ERC baseline 10 errors / 12 warnings; PM acceptance gate
requirements.statement: KiCad ERC shall report 0 errors and 0 unresolved warnings; each of the 10 baseline errors and 12 baseline warnings is resolved or waived with a written reason.

requirements.source: DRC baseline 7 errors / 17 warnings; PM acceptance gate
requirements.statement: KiCad DRC against the generic_two_layer profile shall report 0 errors and 0 unresolved warnings; each of the 7 baseline errors and 17 baseline warnings is resolved or waived with a written reason.
With USB-C 5 V applied, the +3V3 rail shall measure 3.3 V +/-3% under a 500 mA load and board inrush shall not trip the host port.
An I2C scan shall detect exactly one device at address 0x48 and TMP102 readings shall track ambient within +/-2 degC over 15 to 35 degC.
